selected_experts.reason: To confirm the object is correctly classified as a necklace and distinguish it from other jewelry types like bracelets.
To verify that the interlocking links are topologically separate entities and not fused together, and to check boundary sharpness of the gemstones.
To assess the realism of the specular highlights on the metal and the refraction/clarity of the gemstones, which are common failure points in AI generation.

focus_areas: Integrity of interlocking chain links (no fusion)
Realism of metal reflections and shadows
Clarity and physical attachment of gemstone settings
Structural logic of the clasp mechanism
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the connection points between the chain links and the medallions. AI often fails to render clear jump rings or attachment loops, causing parts to float or merge. Also, verify if the 'faceted' stones actually look like cut glass/crystal or just blurry blobs.
